## About
West Coast Auto Collision is a family-owned and operated body shop at 1420 Morena Blvd in San Diego. Whether it's a minor dent or a major accident, we can repair your car and reverse the damage.
Miguel Felix manages the shop, and you'll talk with him directly. Reviewers describe us as friendly and honest, and say we keep you in the loop on what's going on with your car.
If your car is in bad shape, we'll tow it, set you up with a rental and work with your insurance company. We're rated 5 from 112 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto Collision Repairs: After a major or minor accident, we repair your car and reverse the damage caused.
- Minor Dent Repair: Dents and dings taken care of so your car looks right again.
- Major Collision Damage Repair: Repairs for bigger damage after a serious accident.
- Auto Body Painting: We paint over scratched surfaces and make your car look as good as new.
- Classic Car Restoration: Our professionally trained technicians work on classic cars and motorcycles and restore them to pristine condition.
- Towing and rental: If your vehicle is in bad condition, we'll tow it in and set you up with a rental.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us or send a request and we'll give you a free estimate.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes, we'll work with your insurance company on your repair.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
